Alert.responsive: Ekranga moslashadi: mobilda action tugmasi matn ostiga tushadi, yopish tugmasi barmoq uchun kattalashadi; desktopda paddinglar kengroq va matn 16px. true — barcha breakpointlar yoki ["m", "t"] kabi ro'yxat
